candidate.name: F2_VERIFIED_PRIVATE_RELEASE_STAGING_V1
candidate.purpose: Close the currently unspecified ZIP->materialized package-root boundary without replacing release_integrity or creating a second installer/state/effect authority.

required_semantics: The staging API owns creation of a fresh empty private temporary directory; callers do not supply an arbitrary extraction destination for the admitted one-handoff path.
Hash the received archive bytes and bind the digest plus declared release/build/pre-handoff identity before member extraction.

Enumerate every ZIP member before writing. Reject empty/noncanonical names, NUL, backslash ambiguity, absolute/drive/UNC roots, dot/dotdot components, exact duplicate names, unsupported special/link-like member metadata, and target-profile path collisions.
Use one F2 canonical member-name parser rather than relying on host ZipFile.extract normalization to define authority semantics.
Materialize regular files/directories only inside the fresh staging root. Do not execute Python imports, scripts, host hooks, installers or payload binaries during extraction/preflight.

After extraction, call the existing load_and_verify_release_manifest and portable static-completeness gates against the staged root. Those existing gates remain authoritative for file-set/hash/no-link scope.
Only after all post-extraction gates pass may the staged root be exposed to host-route selection/install logic.
On any failure, return BLOCKED/REJECTED, delete disposable staging where safe, and mint zero install/runtime/completion credit.

Receipt must bind archive SHA-256, extractor schema/runtime version, target path-profile identifier, staged verification result and exact F2 source/build identity. Do not persist secrets or user state in the release artifact.

windows_profile: case-insensitive aliases where the selected filesystem profile is case-insensitive
junction/reparse-point checks after materialization remain in the WP1111 path-hardening lane
target_profile_collision_minimum.note: Do not invent universal Windows/macOS filesystem behavior. Bind the path-profile used by the acceptance case and fail closed on unknown collision semantics.

minimum_adversarial_tests: clean deterministic ZIP -> fresh staging -> release_integrity PASS
archive member ../escape -> preflight REJECT before writes
case/normalization collision under an explicit target profile -> preflight REJECT
special or link-like member metadata -> preflight REJECT
caller attempts to force extraction into a pre-existing arbitrary tree -> API unavailable or fail closed
post-extraction inserted symlink/junction/non-regular entry -> existing F2 verifier REJECT
payload hash mutation -> existing F2 manifest verifier REJECT
no installer/import/hook execution occurs before verification
failed staging cleans disposable files without touching canonical user state
non_goals: Do not replace WP1110/WP1111 route/junction hardening.
Do not import libpathrs/filepath-securejoin or another framework for the portable baseline.
Do not claim race-proof hostile-filesystem containment from pathlib/zipfile lexical checks.
Do not grant target-host, installer, effect, runtime or whole-system credit from repository tests.
Do not make VPS/HCU a prerequisite for local one-handoff install.

optional_future_hardening.condition: Only if the accepted threat model includes concurrent hostile mutation of the staging filesystem or a target-host falsifier defeats fresh-private staging.
optional_future_hardening.candidate: platform-specific handle/dirfd confinement such as Linux openat2 RESOLVE_BENEATH/RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS or an equivalently evidenced primitive

why_this_is_minimal: It reuses the existing F2 release manifest and verifier instead of duplicating integrity authority.
It adds no model calls and no mandatory external dependency.
It converts the required ZIP handoff from an unspecified materialization step into an explicit testable gate.
It structurally removes the E3 pre-existing-destination condition for the normal admitted path by owning fresh staging creation.
It preserves portability while leaving stronger OS-specific containment available only when evidence requires it.
next_exact_action: Trigger4 should refresh current main, route around WP1110/WP1111 overlap, implement the smallest stdlib-only F2_VERIFIED_PRIVATE_RELEASE_STAGING_V1 candidate, run repository tests/adversarial fixtures, and only then decide whether a real target-host acceptance probe is admitted. Trigger6 must not mint E6.
